intro: SInC sits at the intersection of campus innovation and India's startup ecosystem. Our network spans IIT Delhi alumni, industry mentors, seed investors, and partners who show up for founders.

alumni.name: IIT Delhi Alumni Founders
alumni.bio: Alumni who've built and scaled startups — available for office hours, pitch feedback, and warm intros.

alumni.name: Campus E-Cell Network
alumni.bio: Cross-club collaboration with E-Cell and domain clubs for hackathons, ideation sprints, and co-building.

investors.name: Seed-stage angel network
investors.bio: Angels and micro-VCs who attend SInC pitch nights and Demo Day — actively scouting IIT Delhi deals.

investors.name: R&I Park, IIT Delhi
investors.bio: Research & Innovation Park provides infrastructure, lab access, and a bridge to deep-tech commercialization.

experts.name: Startup legal clinic
experts.bio: Lawyers covering incorporation, co-founder agreements, and IP — open clinic format for cohort teams.

experts.name: Industry mentors
experts.bio: Practitioners from target sectors who stress-test product, GTM, and unit economics with founders.

upcoming.description: Site visit with an industrial partner — open to Cohort 1.0 teams. Details shared with accepted founders.

past.description: Orientation visit for early SInC founders — labs, incubation space, and mentor introductions.

comingSoon.title: Team matching
comingSoon.description: Founders post role requirements; students apply with skill tags. Screening before contact is shared.

comingSoon.title: Bounty board
comingSoon.description: Startups post tasks for students — solve a problem, earn a reward. Launching with Cohort 1.0.
